Vector MICROSAR with TRACE32 Trace over ARTI Hooks

This archive provides an implementation to trace Vector's VTH interface
with Lauterbach's TRACE32 tools. It uses the AUTOSAR ARTI standard and
supports tracing of task states and RTE hooks.


REQUIREMENTS:

- TRACE32 Version R2023-02 or higher


CONTENTS:

- readme.txt
  This file

- vth_to_arti.h
  Header file mapping the VTH hooks to ARTI hooks

- CreateLauterbachRunnableMeasurementPoints.dvgroovy
  Skript within DaVinci Configurator to create RTE Hook implementations.
  It calls gen_vector_rte_hook.py

- gen_vector_rte_*.py
  Python scripts to create ARTI Hook implementations.

- ../../common
  Directory to be copied to your project (SIP)

- ../../scripts
  Directory containing scripts to trace the ARTI hooks


QUICK GUIDE

1. Copy CreateLauterbachRunnableMeasurementPoints.dvgroovy
   to your SIP folder: SIP\external\DaVinciConfigurator\AutomationScripts.

2. Copy gen_vector_rte_hook.py
   to your application folder, e.g. SIP\internal\MyProject.

3. edit gen_vector_rte_hook.py, adjust input and output paths if necessary:
   - pathRteHook = "./Appl/GenData/Rte_Hook.h"               # generated by RTE
   - pathRteHookArti = "./Appl/Source/Rte_Hook_Arti.c"       # generated by this script
   - pathRteRunnable = "./Appl/Lauterbach/rte_runnable.cmm"  # generated by this script

4. Copy vth_to_arti.h to your application's include folder,
   e.g. SIP\internal\MyProject\Appl\Include.

5. Copy common\arti.h, common\arti_common.h and *all subfolders* of "common" 
   to your application's include folder, e.g. SIP\internal\MyProject\Appl\Include.
   Edit the arti.h file therein and select your tracing method.
   Read the readme.txt file of your selected tracing method.

6. Copy common\arti.c to your application's source folder,
   e.g. SIP\internal\MyProject\Appl\Source.

7. Edit your makefile, e.g. SIP\internal\MyProject\Appl\Makefile.project.part.defines:
   - add APP_SOURCE_LST += Source\arti.c
   - add APP_SOURCE_LST += Source\Rte_Hook_Arti.c
   - comment other Rte_Hook implementations (e.g. Rte_Hook_Rtm.c)

8. Enable ORTI and include the VTH headers in DaVinci Configurator:
   - Runtime System -> Runtime System General -> OS -> Debugging
     - ORTI Debug Support: ORTI_23_ADDITIONAL
     - Timing Hooks Include Header: + vth_to_arti.h

9. Include VFB tracing in DaVinci Configurator:
   - Runtime System -> Runtime System General -> RTE -> VFB Tracing
     - enable VFB Tracing
     - add VFB Trace Functions that you want to be traced

10. Generate your project in DaVinci Configurator.

11. Generate RTE hooks and helper script in DaVinci Configurator:
    - View -> Script Tasks -> CreateLauterbachRunnableMeasurementPoints
      Execute Sub-Task "CreateLauterbachRunnableMeasurementPoints".
      This generates "Rte_Hook_Arti.c" and "rte_runnable.cmm" in the directories set in step 3.

12. Add an Arti_Init() call to the initialization code, e.g. in EcuM:
    - Edit SIP\internal\MyProject\Appl\Source\EcuM_CalloutStubs.c, EcuM_AL_DriverInitOne():
      add:
        void Arti_Init(void);
        Arti_Init();

13. Build your application
